producer_report.summary: The root-cause request body in root_cause_request_at now asks first that the information the failing stage lacked be given to it (its brief, the system facts or the reader's inputs). It allows a new refusal rule only when that cannot prevent the failure, and then requires the line 'Expected share of past accepted readings it would refuse: N%'. A new fixture test checks the order and wording, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry. `cargo test -p athena-core hestia` (71 tests), `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` all pass. I did not run clippy or the full workspace suite. The replay's refusal share is not measured, as it runs on Athena's side.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs builds a root-cause request with root_cause_request from a fixture introspection/cause and asserts the text asks first (earlier position in the text) for the missing information to be supplied to the failing stage (brief, system facts or reader's inputs). Check: cargo test -p athena-core hestia passes and the test is listed.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_root_cause_request_asks_for_missing_information_before_any_refusal_rule passed in cargo test -p athena-core hestia; asserts info position < rule position and brief/system facts/reader's inputs.

criteria_check.criterion: The same test asserts the text mentions adding a refusal rule only as allowed when giving the information cannot prevent the failure, and requires the request to state the expected share of past accepted readings it would refuse; the asserted refusal-rule mention comes after the information ask. Check: cargo test -p athena-core hestia.
criteria_check.evidence: Same test asserts the rule sentence, the 'Expected share of past accepted readings it would refuse: N%' line after it, and exactly one 'refusal rule' mention.

criteria_check.criterion: The test fails against the old body text: the diff of crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs shows the old body (find the cause where it originates...) extended in root_cause_request_at with the new paragraphs and no other change to the acceptance list semantics.
criteria_check.evidence: Diff only appends two paragraphs to the body string in root_cause_request_at; acceptance array untouched; the old text lacks the asserted phrases.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing root-cause tests (e.g. the ones near the_root_cause_request_is_high_and_refuses_a_cause_that_reads_as_acceptance) still pass, and the built request still passes plain_boundary_text and the no-bullet-line rule. Check: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: All 71 hestia tests pass including the existing root-cause ones; request passes plain_boundary_text since the new test unwraps Ok. Full athena-core suite not run.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks (fmt also run by me, passes).

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry describing the root-cause template change (information first, refusal rule only with an expected refusal share). Check: git diff CHANGELOG.md.
criteria_check.evidence: Entry added at top of Unreleased/Changed.

criteria_check.criterion: The file list of the change contains only crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs and CHANGELOG.md. Check: git status.

learnings: Bash hook blocks head/tail; only cargo, git, chmod, ls, mv, rm are allowed.
